[[File:Cockatrice icon.png|left]]
'''Cockatrices''' are [[Slayer]] monsters that require level 25 Slayer to kill. They frequently drop [[limpwurt root]]s used in the [[Herblore]] skill, and rarely drop the [[Cockatrice head]], which can be brought to the [[Taxidermist]] in [[Canifis]] and stuffed for 2,000 gp. Wearing the [[Mask of Stone]] doubles the drop rate.

In the quest [[Fur 'n Seek]], [[cockatrice skin]] must be collected and cleaned for the [[Odd Old Man]].

==Protective equipment==
Equipment is necessary to avoid the stat-draining attack of the cockatrice. Any of the following can be used:

* [[Mirror shield]]
* [[Mask of Stone]] / [[Helm of Petrification]]
* [[Mask of Reflection]] / [[Helm of Little Kings]]
* [[Sunglasses]]

Not wearing the required equipment results in the following effects:
* Inflicts damage to the player up to a maximum of 11% of their max [[life points]] in typeless damage.
* Lowers [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Magic]], [[Ranged]], and [[Necromancy]] by 40% of their current level. At level 2, it cannot be lowered any further.
* Lowers [[Defence]], [[Agility]], and [[Summoning]] by 20% of their current level. At level 4, it cannot be lowered any further.
* Multiplies current [[prayer points]] and [[summoning points]] by 0.8, with the summoning points drain being calculated before the Summoning level drain.

The [[Slayer helmet]] and all variants do not defend against this attack.

Players without level 20 [[Defence]] will not be assigned a cockatrice [[Slayer assignment]]. Once per day, players can force a cockatrice Slayer assignment by talking to [[Mazchna]] whilst wearing the [[Mask of Stone]] or [[Helm of Petrification]].

==Strengths and weaknesses==
Cockatrices have a special stat-draining attack, which they use if the player is not wearing protective equipment. It will shoot out beams from its eyes, quickly reducing [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Defence]], [[Ranged]], [[Magic]],  [[Necromancy]], [[Agility]], and [[Summoning]] to dangerously low levels (1/4 of the player's original levels, e.g. 15/60) and causes rapid damage for up to 110 life points per hit (it does more damage with higher levels). These beams always hit a fixed amount. This is why a mirror shield is necessary. Use a [[Restore potion|restore]] or [[super restore potion]] to recover from these effects.

If the player is protected, however, they fight using standard [[melee]] and [[ranged]] attacks. They have few life points and do not hit substantially. Their attack speed is the same as a [[scimitar]] or [[mace]]. They are weak against crush attacks, although any melee weapon will suffice.

==Trivia==
* {{wp|Cockatrices}} are part of the real-world mythology, believed to be the result of a chicken egg hatched by a toad of serpent, which is very similar to the {{wp|basilisk}}. The cockatrice shares the same ability to kill people by simply looking at them. Letting them see themselves in a mirror is given as a way to kill them.
